mean.description: Global mean substitution (CO baseline 2.15 mg/m³). Fast computation O(1), but severely dampens temporal variance and fails to capture rush-hour dynamics.

median.description: Median substitution (CO baseline 1.80 mg/m³). Resistant to extreme pollution outlier spikes, but creates flatline artifacts in sensor telemetry.

knn.description: K-Nearest Neighbors (k=3) based on multi-sensor atmospheric proximity (PT08.S1, C6H6, NOx, Temperature). Reconstructs smooth diurnal curves with 45.83 MAE.
